questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: 'If only I _____ that crucial meeting yesterday! I could have explained my side properly.'
options: had known
would know
knew
had known

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation?
options: If I were you, I would have taken the job.
If I was you, I would have taken the job.
I wish I was in London yesterday.
I wish I were in London yesterday.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would have taken the job.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences demonstrates correct use of ellipsis?
options: She said she would come, but she didn’t.
She said she would come, but she didn’t come.
She said she would come, but she didn’t come yesterday.
She said she would come, but she didn’t come yesterday, did she?
questions.answer: She said she would come, but she didn’t come yesterday.

questions.question: Select the sentence that correctly employs a cleft sentence to emphasize the location.
options: It was in the garden that we first met.
It was in the garden where we first met.
We first met in the garden.
That was where we first met in the garden.
questions.answer: It was in the garden that we first met.

questions.question: Choose the correct form to complete the sentence: 'Had he been more careful, the accident _____.'
options: might not have occurred
might not occur
would not have occurred
would not occur
